review_scope: Source-only protected review of the final D127c candidate against parent e319fdbcd512bd5fc9bc5b2c43abfa4d749c34d9, the author evidence, PLAN A2/A3/P2, and C0 sections 1-5 and 7.

findings.summary: The selector profiles every matching element request and accepts mixed command arrays; it does not enforce one element-only first POST or a deterministic first/retry choice.
The optional raw-pstats path accepts an existing or symlinked parent after resolution and chmods that parent, so it does not guarantee a private dedicated 0700 parent or reject unsafe parent paths.
A profile factory enable failure has no finally cleanup; a partial enable can leave the profile binding installed while the request is marked unavailable.
The added tests do not cover the required wrong-suite/request/path/method and unselected-handler controls, symlink/overwrite rejection, projection byte bounds, or exact caller-edge call counts.
The scoped Pyright and mypy runs report new Stats.stats attribute errors; the author validation did not qualify the requested type checks.
